title: La Union warns vs AI-generated images using police uniforms, insignia

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The provincial government of La Union has warned against creating, sharing or using artificial intelligence (AI)-generated images depicting individuals wearing police uniforms. It also cautions against the use of insignia, identification cards or other official markings of the Philippine National Police (PNP).
